safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting dizziness removes a potentially important systemic symptom that can suggest more serious allergic reaction physiology (e.g., presyncope/hypotension) and would normally heighten urgency and monitoring needs. In this encounter, the clinician already escalated to emergency services for suspected anaphylaxis, so the omission is less likely to change immediate management but can still degrade clinical documentation quality.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Stating “no exam/vitals documented” in a way that negates observed clinical status can mislead downstream clinicians into underestimating severity, since the transcript includes observed/progressive lip swelling and breathing difficulty prompting emergency escalation. This type of documentation error can adversely affect triage and handoff decisions in a potentially life-threatening presentation.
